universal_patterns.pattern: any person applying to any department, board, commission[^.]*license

proposal.rationale: Refined for RI based on review of undetermined sections. Chapter 5-76 (tax delinquency/license issuance) and Chapter 5-88 (professional service license for military/spouses) are both genuinely universal across all RI occupational licensing boards — they apply to "any person applying to any department, board, commission, division, authority, or other agency" for a license to conduct a profession/trade/business, and to "each business/profession-related board". Added targeted universal_patterns that match the distinctive phrasing of these umbrella-style chapters without being so broad as to falsely match other chapters. Citation patterns unchanged: RI uses "chapter N of title M" and "§ M-C-S" where the middle segment is the chapter token (with possible decimal chapter numbers like 17.10).
